name: p-islands-golden
js: (()=>{const app=window.__CITY_APP;if(!document.body.classList.contains('hud-minimized'))document.getElementById('btn-toggle-hud').click();const p=window.CITY.worldFromLatLon(43.6215,-79.3772);const cn=window.CITY.GEO.points.cnTower;const L=[cn[0],150,cn[1]];app.teleportTo(p.x,p.z,0);app.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>({pos:[p.x,4.0,p.z],look:L,fov:46});})();(async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));await sleep(3000);let n=0;const t=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{(function f(){n++;if(performance.now()-t<5000)requestAnimationFrame(f);else res()})()});console.log('[perf] p-islands-golden '+((performance.now()-t)/n).toFixed(2)+' ms')})()
